CRT-100.description:
*Business Context*

The request to add taxes as trades' legs via correction, revealed a number of inconsistencies in the way trading transactions are identified throughout the system, namely:
 * EOD report and Account transactions widgets in DXTrade and WebBroker client's area use internal transaction id.
 * Transactions API, FIX drop-copy, and multi-account Transactions widget in WebBroker use external transaction id.
 * Trades widget in DXTrade show{color:#172b4d}s the internal transaction id of the execution, w{color}hich changes after correction. Shall be replaced with the internal id of the execution chain.

_Note to analysts: All ids listed above have the <session code>:<action code> format. Please be more specific than that and indicate whether the id is (1) of the internal or external order/execution and (2) of a particular execution/order or of an execution/order chain. For orders, whenever we display the current/latest state of the order, we shall use the order chain id that doesn't change when the order changes states; for the detailed history of the order execution (aka order history), each change of the state (= record in the history) is identified by an order id; in both cases, we shall use ids of the internal order._

We have two problems to fix immediately for Corner:

(1) In the Corner configuration, we shall use the same trade id on all steps of the trade flow between DX and Corner: FIX drop copy, EOD Trades report, Transactions API.

(2) The user of the WebBroker shall be able to identify a trade by the same id which is displayed in the client's UIs (internal id).

As the most safe and easy solution, the following shall be done:
 # Introduce external transaction id as an additional field to EOD Trades report and let CB know that the new field shall be used to refer to the trade in the Transaction API in case of a bust or correct.
 # Add an internal transaction id to the Transactions widget in WebBroker to allow operators cross-ref

CRT-171.summary: [PenTest] Sensitive Information Sent via HTTTP GET
CRT-171.description:
see linked BL for description: CRTBL-394

New token login flows should be created here:
1. GET request with path "api/auth/login/token" with header "Authorization: Bearer <token>". Should be used in adaptive app.
2. POST request with path "api/auth/login/token", which should set session cookie. Should be used in regular web app.
3. POST request with path api/auth/login/form-with-token. Should be used from HTML form with parameter "token"
4. GET request with path "api/auth/login/token" and token parameter. Should be used only in testing. It should be disabled by default.

Old flows with root path "/" and path "api/auth/login/external" should be removed.

JSON format for POST request:
{code:java}
{
"username": "testuser",
"token": "XXX"
}
{code}


HTML Form example:
{code:java}
<html>
  <body>
    <form target="_blank" action="https://broqa.prosp.devexperts.com/api/auth/login/form-with-token" method="POST">
	  <input type="text" name="token" value="" />
      <input type="submit" value="Submit request" />
    </form>
  </body>
</html>
{code}

h2. Requirements:
 # Absolute net exposure calculation is moved from [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-865] to [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-981] (not shown in UIs)
 # Introduce Exposure Coverage metric: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-982] (show in dxTrade, in %)
 # Show Exposure Coverage metric in WB: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-991]  (add filter and sorting)
 # Add Exposure Coverage in EOD report: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-992] 

 
h4. Scenario:
 # Net exposure:
The account has no orders and positions. Portfolio value = Account value. Open a position on Futures ZL Sep 25*10, ZL OCT 25*3, and create a limit order that won't be filled.
Calculate the Absolute Net exposure manually: sum of all Instrument exposure on open positions:  (10*49,36 * 600)+ (3 * 49,36 *600) =  385008
 # Exposure coverage: 
After Scenario 1, see the portfolio equity. The Portfolio’s Exposure coverage should be equal to the result of “Equity / Absolute net exposure * 100%”: 121453/ 385008 *100  = 31,54= 32.00%
Compare with Exposure coverage metric in Portfolio Metrics.
Buy ZL Sep 25*2, see the Exposure coverage metric decreased.
 # Exposure coverage metric in WB:
 ## Go to WB, click on the “Account list” widget. In the list of columns see “Exposure coverage”. In list of filters there is filter “Exposure coverage”. Once the column title clicked, the sorting happens.
 ## Open the Client Area -> “Portfolio overview” widget. See the metric there.
 # Exposure coverage in EOD report:
Request the "EODPortfolioMetrics" report. See there is exposure_coverage metric filled with value in scenario 2 in decimal format.

CRT-594.summary: FX_SPOT Pricing (groups and mapping to dxFeed)
CRT-594.description:
*Business Context*

FX Spot instruments have a specific pricing depending on the acccount group and order volume. In this ticket the system should learn how to get the tier-based prices from dxFeed per each account group and map it to the prices that should be shown in UI for the client. 

*Requirements*
 * Quoting scheme for FX_SPOT [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1761]

1. FX_SPOT pricing description: 

1.1. Prices for FX_SPOT instruments should be provided by ET Trader via dxFeed.

1.2. Price determination should depend on account group and volume.
See details in [CRT-1717|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1717]

2. Price mapping to dxFeed:
DxFeed is going to subscribe to continuous tradable price streams from ET Trader and distribute prices to CT per symbol defining currency pair and group - FX_SPOT_BASE_SYMBOL [CRT-1908. |https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1908]
Upon request, DxFeed should provide two types of records to DX:
 * Bid/ask prices [CRT-1713|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1713]
 * Order Book [CRT-1714|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1714]
See details in [CRT-1718|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1718]

3. Account groups:

3.1. New settings domain should be created - [CRT-1630.|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1630]
3.2. New groups in Settings\{FxConfiguration}  should be created for RAG-CH-broker (see in [CRT-1766|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1766] ) and RAG-BS-broker (see in [CRT-1767|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1767] [)|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1716]. Account group name to get prices for the group is to be sourced from FxSpotSuffix [CRT-1768|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1768].

{*}Note{*}: only 1 group (Energy) will be created in the scope o

CRT-669.description:
h2. Requirements:
 * Introduce max liquidation qty on instrument level for CFD/CFD_FOREX/CFD_STOCK instruments: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1891] 
 * Value should be available for update via dxMC
 * Split positions in chunks when max liquidation qty is defined: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1785] 

By default:
 * all instruments with CFD_FOREX_OTC subtype should have max liquidation qty = 200
 * all instruments with CFD_FOREX_DMA subtype should have max liquidation qty = 20 000 000
 * all instruments on CFD/CFD_STOCKS shouldn't have any value and shouldn't be liquidated in chunks by default

{color:#ff0000}(!) Functionality should be ported to 270 branch{color}
h2. Scenario:
 # Create position with qty > max liquidation qty of the instrument (CFD Forex), e.g. 500. There shouldn't be any restriction to send an order > max liquidation qty
 # Increase margin or withdraw cash to make Margin Utilization metric > 100% during trading hours.
 # Liquidation should start and send 2 orders with qty 200 and 1 order with qty 100.
 # Liquidation should complete only after all orders are completed

Repeat the test for non-trading hours: liquidation should wait for trading hours and send same 3 orders. Set one of the orders to be rejected max number of rejections according to config. The other 2 orders should be completed, one remain rejected (according to step 4 in [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1126] ) -> liquidation status should become in review.

 

See the cause of these requirements in the attached email.

CRT-672.summary: Add Taxes, Commissions and External Fees to CA API
CRT-672.description:
*Business Context* 

With the new interface for CA Management AF currently does not send the tax values, which therefore are not displayed in the Taxes field in DX. In addition to the Taxes field, AF also does not send the values for Commission and External Fee.

These fields should be added to the CA API in DX.

*Requirements* 

1. Add three new fields to transaction fields of 'Apply CA Transactions' API:
 * commissions - [CRT-1918|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1918] 
 * fees - [CRT-1919|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1919] 
 * taxes - [CRT-1920|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1920] 

Requirement [CRT-1250|https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1250] was updated accordingly.

*Scenarios*

1. Initiate CA for the instrument. 

2. On 'Apply CA Transactions' step check that API includes three new fields. 

3. Check that the values are displayed in 'Transactions' widget in all UIs (web and wb) and in Account Statement.

4. Check that the values are debited/credited to Total Cash Effect and Balance values.
